color.note: Hildegard's own colours: viriditas green, gold of the Living Light, sapphire of wisdom, ember of the Spirit's fire, burgundy of the Passion and the rubric, vellum white and silver. Dark is the default. Every text token holds 4.5:1 or better on the grounds its note names in both themes.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: App background behind everything. Ink near-black in dark, warm vellum in light.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Sidebars, inspectors and cards that sit on canvas.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Inputs, popovers, menus and anything lifted above panel.

tokens.name: sapphire-deep
tokens.usage: Sapphire ground, Hildegard's colour of wisdom: the Choir diagram, media thumbnails, the prompt bar halo. text-primary and text-muted read on it.

tokens.name: viridian-deep
tokens.usage: Deepest viriditas. App icon ground and the brand-green lockup background, identical in both themes. Text on it uses on-viridian.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and card edges. Carries no meaning alone, so it is exempt from 3:1.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, toggles, chips and any control. At least 3:1 on panel and raised in both themes.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Body copy and headings on canvas, panel, raised and lapis.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary copy and helper text on canvas, panel and raised.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, timestamps and placeholders on canvas, panel, raised and lapis.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Viriditas fill: primary buttons, selected nav, progress. Pair with on-brand.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand fills.

tokens.name: brand-text
tokens.usage: Green used as text or an icon stroke on canvas, panel or raised.

tokens.name: sapphire
tokens.usage: Sapphire fill: selected media, links set as buttons, the queued ring. Pair with on-sapphire.

tokens.name: on-sapphire
tokens.usage: Text and icons on sapphire fills.

tokens.name: sapphire-text
tokens.usage: Sapphire as text or an icon stroke: links, model names in prose, queued states. On canvas, panel, raised and sapphire-deep.

tokens.name: ember
tokens.usage: Ember fill: Force now and nothing else that is not urgent. Pair with on-ember.

tokens.name: on-ember
tokens.usage: Text and icons on ember fills.

tokens.name: ember-text
tokens.usage: Ember as text: money spent on outside APIs, the interruption line in Force now. On canvas, panel, raised and sapphire-deep.

tokens.name: burgundy
tokens.usage: Burgundy fill: destructive confirmations and the rubric drop initial. Pair with on-burgundy.

tokens.name: on-burgundy
tokens.usage: Text on burgundy fills.

tokens.name: burgundy-text
tokens.usage: Burgundy as text: rubric headings in onboarding and errors. On canvas, panel, raised and sapphire-deep.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Gold leaf, the Living Light: live-state marks, the running ring, ornament rules. Pair with on-gold. Never the only signal of a state.

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Text and icons on gold fills.

tokens.name: gold-text
tokens.usage: Gold as text or an icon stroke on canvas, panel or raised.

tokens.name: state-running
tokens.usage: Running jobs. Always an animated ring plus the word Running; gold alone never signals it.

tokens.name: state-queued
tokens.usage: Queued jobs. Hollow dot plus the word Queued.

tokens.name: state-idle
tokens.usage: Idle devices. Dash glyph plus the word Idle.

tokens.name: state-error
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive confirmations. Triangle glyph plus a sentence that says what failed.

tokens.name: state-saved
tokens.usage: Money saved by running locally. Always printed with a minus-free plus sign and the word saved.

tokens.name: state-spent
tokens.usage: Money spent on outside APIs, in ember. Always printed with the word spent.

tokens.name: on-viridian
tokens.usage: Vellum text and strokes on viridian-deep and brand-green lockups.

tokens.name: gold-leaf
tokens.usage: Gold on viridian-deep: the lens in the mark, hairline ornament on the green lockup, 8:1 on that ground.

tokens.name: silver
tokens.usage: Silver, the Spirit's colour in the Rupertsberg Scivias: Choir orbit lines and idle device rings. Decorative only.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Two pixel keyboard and switch-control focus ring with a two pixel offset. 3:1 or better on every surface.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind sheets, dialogs and the Force now confirmation.

families.mono: "DM Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Onboarding welcome and the empty-gallery line on expanded windows. 24px and up only: Cormorant is too light below that.
styles.sample: Every work begins as a vision.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Screen titles on expanded windows, hero numerals on medium.

styles.name: display-sm
styles.usage: Screen titles on medium and compact windows, section heroes.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Panel and card titles in the display face. The smallest size Cormorant is used at.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Dialog titles, sheet titles, device names.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Reading text on compact windows and the minimum size for phone text fields (16px prevents iOS focus zoom).
styles.sample: Lend this laptop when you are away.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default interface text on expanded and medium windows.
styles.sample: Your work stays on your devices.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Row titles, button labels, emphasised values.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Secondary lines, table cells, helper text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Chip labels, tabs, form labels, pill text.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Timestamps, footnotes, axis text. 12px is the floor.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Section eyebrows in capitals. Never for sentences.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Model names, logs, job ids, addresses, pairing codes.

styles.name: mono-sm
styles.usage: Inline costs, sizes and VRAM in dense rows.

styles.name: figure-md
styles.usage: Cost and savings figures in strips and cards.

styles.name: figure-lg
styles.usage: The one big number on Costs and the tray popover.

styles.name: initial
styles.usage: A single drop initial on Onboarding and the empty gallery. Decorative: never a word, never a label, never in function.

spacing.note: A 4px base. Hit targets are 44px minimum on touch windows and 32px minimum for pointer-only dense rows.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, chip inner gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks, row inner padding, button icon gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control inner padding, list row gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, compact window gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Panel padding on expanded windows.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section gap, medium window gutter.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Expanded window gutter, large section gap.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Hero spacing.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between screen regions on wide windows.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Onboarding vertical rhythm.

tokens.name: target-dense
tokens.usage: Smallest pointer target, in dense tables on a mouse or trackpad. Never on touch windows.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Smallest touch target on iOS and iPadOS. Every tappable control meets it on medium and compact windows.

tokens.name: target-comfort
tokens.usage: Android touch target and the default row height on phones.

radius.note: App icons follow the platform mask; the radii here are for in-app surfaces.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Tags, progress tracks, waveform bars.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, inputs, small buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, list rows, popovers.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, tiles and gallery thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Panels, sheets and the prompt bar.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills, switches, the modality chips.

tokens.name: radius-icon
tokens.usage: Rounded-square app icon corner on macOS and iOS preview tiles.

shadow.note: Elevation is mostly a lighter surface in dark and a soft shadow in light. The only glow is the living-light halo on running work.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Cards resting on panel.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, the tray popover.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and the Force now confirmation on compact windows.

tokens.name: glow-force
tokens.usage: The ember halo on Force now while it waits for confirmation.

tokens.name: glow-live
tokens.usage: The living-light halo on a running job and the active device node. Paired with an animated ring and a label.

layout.note: Window classes, not devices: compact under 600px, medium 600 to 839px, expanded 840px and up, wide 1280px and up.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Expanded sidebar with labels.

tokens.name: rail-width
tokens.usage: Medium window navigation rail: icon over label.

tokens.name: inspector-width
tokens.usage: Right inspector on wide windows. Becomes a sheet below 1280px.

tokens.name: topbar-height
tokens.usage: Top bar on every window class.

tokens.name: tabbar-height
tokens.usage: Bottom tab bar on compact windows, plus the safe-area inset.

tokens.name: strip-height
tokens.usage: The persistent cluster and savings strip.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Maximum reading column in browser mode. Wider windows centre it.

tokens.name: gutter-compact
tokens.usage: Side gutter on compact windows.

tokens.name: gutter-medium
tokens.usage: Side gutter on medium windows.

tokens.name: gutter-expanded
tokens.usage: Side gutter on expanded and wide windows.

tokens.name: tray-width
tokens.usage: Menu bar and system tray popover width.

tokens.name: frame-phone
tokens.usage: Column width when a person forces Phone layout on a wider window.

tokens.name: frame-tablet
tokens.usage: Column width when a person forces Tablet layout on a wider window.

tokens.name: frame-desktop
tokens.usage: Viewport width a phone or tablet browser is given when a person forces Desktop layout; pinch zoom stays on.

tokens.name: titlebar-height
tokens.usage: Desktop shell title bar drag region on macOS, Windows and Linux.

tokens.name: titlebar-inset-mac
tokens.usage: Left inset that clears the macOS traffic lights in the desktop shell.

tokens.name: titlebar-inset-win
tokens.usage: Right inset that clears Windows caption buttons in the desktop shell.

breakpoint.note: Query the app container width, never the user agent. Matches Android window size classes and iOS size classes: iPhone is compact, iPad portrait medium, iPad landscape and desktop expanded or wide.

tokens.name: bp-medium
tokens.usage: First width of the medium window class: phone landscape, small tablets, narrow browser windows.

tokens.name: bp-expanded
tokens.usage: First width of the expanded class: sidebar with labels. iPad landscape, Android expanded, every laptop window.

tokens.name: bp-wide
tokens.usage: First width of the wide class: the inspector docks beside the work instead of opening as a sheet.

stroke.note: Icons are drawn on a 24px grid with round caps and joins.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers and card edges.

tokens.name: stroke-icon
tokens.usage: Every interface icon at 20 and 24px.

tokens.name: stroke-icon-bold
tokens.usage: Icons at 16px and the selected tab icon.

tokens.name: stroke-ring
tokens.usage: Concentric ring progress and the Choir orbits.

tokens.name: stroke-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring width.

tokens.name: focus-offset
tokens.usage: Gap between a control and its focus ring.
